title: Final Answers
description: Essential Criteria: Provide the correct final answers for the beam candle-power ratio and the angular size of the star disk.

title: Physical Principles
description: Important Criteria: Clearly describe the physical principles involved in lens/mirror arrangements and polarization methods.

title: Geometric Relationships
description: Important Criteria: Derive and explain the geometric relationships used to find the distance between the source and the focal point.

title: Polarization Process
description: Important Criteria: Explain the process of producing and analyzing circularly polarized light using polarizers and wave plates.

title: Interferometer Explanation
description: Important Criteria: Describe how the Michelson interferometer works to estimate the size of distant stellar sources.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: Ensure that all units used in calculations and descriptions are consistent and correctly applied.

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: Avoid common errors such as sign mistakes or incorrect application of formulas in the derivations.

title: Assumptions Clarification
description: Optional Criteria: Clearly state any assumptions made regarding the light source or optical components.
